definitions: Flat dishes from which food is eaten.
Thin, flat pieces of metal or other hard material, typically square or circular, used for various purposes.
A flat piece of metal or plastic attached to the front and back of a vehicle, bearing its registration number.
A photograph taken on a photographic plate.
examples: She stacked the plates in the dishwasher.
The car's number plates were stolen.
He installed the solar plates on the roof.
The X-ray plates showed a fracture.
